submissions.note:
- `src/point_add/mod.rs`: enables the clean dialog-GCD defaults, including the validated tail nonce.

- `src/point_add/rounds/dialog/config.rs`: adds the clean compare schedule and carry/clean defaults used by this port.

- `src/point_add/rounds/dialog/compressed.rs`: reuses current-block compressed sidecar cells for scratch in the dialog-GCD schedule.

This submission adds one fresh exact closure pass after the existing identity-strip stage. The pass repeatedly applies an already-defined target-fanout conjugation until it reaches a fixpoint. On the submitted circuit, the closure applies exactly ten times and removes ten redundant nonlinear operations without changing the circuit topology or qubit count.

The default tail nonce is updated to `8000230021249`. This nonce belongs to the submitted post-strip stream. It is not transported from a different circuit geometry. Changing the nonce changes the self-seeded test stream, so the final claim is based on a complete nonce-specific trusted evaluation rather than on the structural rewrite alone.
